# Agent: PPTX → Sora 2 Video

## Purpose

Convert a PowerPoint presentation (`.pptx`) into a stitched MP4 video by:

1. Extracting per-slide PNG images and speaker notes from the PPTX.
2. Generating a short video clip for each slide using the **Sora 2** model (image→video, anchored on the slide PNG with notes as guidance).
3. Stitching all per-slide clips into a single `final.mp4`.

---

## Skills Used

| Step | Skill | Location |
|------|-------|----------|
| Extract slides & notes | `pptx-slides-notes` | `.github/skills/pptx-slides-notes/` |
| Generate + stitch video | `sora2-video` | `.github/skills/sora2-video/` |

Skills are loaded on-demand according to the [GitHub Agent Skills model](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/using-github-copilot/using-github-copilots-agent-mode#about-agent-skills).

---

## Input Contract

| Parameter | Default | Description |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `pptx_path` | `input/deck.pptx` | Path to the source PPTX file |

---

## Output Contract

All outputs are written relative to the repository root:

```
output/
  slides/
    slide-001.png          # Per-slide PNG (1-indexed, zero-padded to 3 digits)
    slide-002.png
    ...
  notes/
    slide-001.txt          # Per-slide speaker notes (plain text)
    slide-002.txt
    ...
  video/
    clips/
      slide-001.mp4        # Per-slide video clip generated by Sora 2
      slide-002.mp4
      ...
    manifest.json          # Maps slide → prompt → Sora job ID → clip file
    final.mp4              # Final stitched video
```

### `manifest.json` schema

```json
{
  "pptx": "input/deck.pptx",
  "generated_at": "<YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ>",
  "slides": [
    {
      "index": 1,
      "slide_image": "output/slides/slide-001.png",
      "notes_file": "output/notes/slide-001.txt",
      "prompt": "<text prompt sent to Sora>",
      "job_id": "<Sora job ID>",
      "clip": "output/video/clips/slide-001.mp4",
      "status": "succeeded"
    }
  ]
}
```

---

## Workflow

```
pptx_path
    │
    ▼
[Skill: pptx-slides-notes]
    extract_slides.py  ──► output/slides/slide-NNN.png
    extract_notes.py   ──► output/notes/slide-NNN.txt
    │
    ▼
[Skill: sora2-video]
    sora_generate.py   ──► submit one Sora 2 image→video job per slide
    poll_jobs.py       ──► poll all jobs until complete, download clips
    stitch_ffmpeg.sh   ──► ffmpeg concat ──► output/video/final.mp4
```

---

## Required Secrets & Environment Variables

| Secret / Env Var | Description |
|------------------|-------------|
| `SORA_ENDPOINT` | Azure AI Foundry endpoint for Sora 2 (e.g. `https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/`) |
| `SORA_API_KEY` | API key for the Sora 2 deployment |
| `SORA_DEPLOYMENT` | Sora 2 deployment name (default: `sora`) |

All secrets are injected via GitHub Actions Secrets; **no secrets are committed to the repository**.

---

## Running Locally

```bash
# 1. Install dependencies
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 2. Export required secrets
export SORA_ENDPOINT="https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/"
export SORA_API_KEY="<your-key>"
export SORA_DEPLOYMENT="sora"   # optional, default: sora

# 3. Extract slides and notes
python .github/skills/pptx-slides-notes/scripts/extract_slides.py \
    --pptx input/deck.pptx --out output/slides

python .github/skills/pptx-slides-notes/scripts/extract_notes.py \
    --pptx input/deck.pptx --out output/notes

# 4. Submit Sora jobs and poll
python .github/skills/sora2-video/scripts/sora_generate.py \
    --slides-dir output/slides --notes-dir output/notes \
    --manifest output/video/manifest.json

python .github/skills/sora2-video/scripts/poll_jobs.py \
    --manifest output/video/manifest.json \
    --clips-dir output/video/clips

# 5. Stitch final video
bash .github/skills/sora2-video/scripts/stitch_ffmpeg.sh \
    output/video/clips output/video/final.mp4
```

---

## Running in CI (GitHub Actions)

Trigger the `pptx-to-video` workflow via **workflow_dispatch**:

```
Actions → "PPTX to Sora 2 Video" → Run workflow → pptx_path: input/deck.pptx
```

The artifact `video-output` will be uploaded upon completion containing the full `output/video/` directory.
